items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I mean when Ella Fitzgerald was at her top.

ctx.x: - No, that's out of the question. I mean the greatest -- the only thing -- Joe Louis -- that was one of the greatest -- and Jackie Robinson -- one of the greatest of our time. They would go to see him fight or go see him play, but they never greeted him. Not once when he got off the plane or the train was there hundreds or thousands -- not hundreds or thousands, just a bunch of people to meet him -- like I said, his family or his agent would be there. And that's about the

size of it. Nobody else. So, where does your encouragement come from. When James Brown was at his hottest -- Ray Charles -- I mean even Martin Luther King, when he came to town, it was more to meet him I would say than anybody else. But it still wasn't that many -- it should have been millions, you know. A few friends -- maybe 50, 60 people -- a hundred people. Oh man, it's hard to explain. I should let -- I'll ask a question -- let them explain it themselves why didn't they support their people like the other…
